mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% annually, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% over the previous two months and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it indicates a supply-side slowdown with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 2 months and FEDFUNDS > 3%
regime_hint: supply-side slowdown with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
